strings.El Game Booster sigue activo: hay servic: Game Booster is still on: services are paused and apps are closed.
strings.Para cambiar de idioma, OptiEleven se vu: To change the language, OptiEleven restarts. Unapplied changes on the sheet will be lost.
strings.Una copia del sistema a la que volver si: A system snapshot to go back to if something goes wrong.
strings.Los ajustes que tienes activados, en un: The tweaks you have on, in a .json for another PC or a fresh install.
strings.Deja los interruptores como en el perfil: Sets the switches as in the profile. Check the change sheet and apply.
strings.Reinicia la barra de tareas y el escrito: Restarts the taskbar and desktop so interface changes show up.
strings.La carpeta con el estado original de cad: The folder with the original state of every tweak and the panel log.
strings.Diagnósticos al mínimo que permite Windo: Diagnostics at the minimum Windows Pro allows, no improvement program (CEIP), no app inventory and none of the scheduled tasks that collect data.
strings.Quita el ID de publicidad, las apps que: Removes the advertising ID, the apps Windows installs on its own, tips, the ads in Settings and Start, and the "let's finish setting up your PC" prompt.
strings.Desactiva Copilot, Recall, Click to Do,: Turns off Copilot, Recall, Click to Do, the AI in Paint and Notepad, and the AI service that starts with Windows (WSAIFabricSvc).
strings.Windows deja de registrar y subir lo que: Windows stops recording and uploading what you open, and the clipboard no longer syncs to the cloud.
strings.La búsqueda del menú Inicio solo busca e: Start search only searches your PC: no web results, no daily "highlights" and no cloud account search.
strings.Desactiva el panel de Widgets (y su proc: Turns off the Widgets board (and its background WebView process).
strings.Escritura y voz sin enviar datos: Typing and voice without sending data
strings.Windows deja de aprender de lo que escri: Windows stops learning from what you type and draw, reading your contacts for the keyboard, and sending your voice to Microsoft.
strings.Windows no te vuelve a preguntar \"¿qué: Windows stops asking "how do you like...?" and doesn't send the answer.
strings.Microsoft Edge sin segundo plano ni tele: Microsoft Edge without background or telemetry
strings.Edge deja de quedarse abierto al cerrarl: Edge stops staying open after you close it and preloading at startup (6 to 10 processes and about 300 MB of RAM), with no Copilot sidebar, shopping or recommendations. Edge will say "managed by your organization".
strings.Word, Excel y compañía dejan de enviar d: Word, Excel and the rest stop sending usage data and asking for feedback. Does nothing if you don't have Office.
strings.Variables de entorno oficiales para que: Official environment variables so PowerShell 7 and the .NET tools don't send usage data.
strings.Windows deja de guardar la ubicación del: Windows stops saving your PC's location to your account. On a laptop, that's what helps if it gets stolen.
strings.DiagTrack (experiencias del usuario cone: DiagTrack (connected user experiences), dmwappushservice, InventorySvc (app inventory for Microsoft) and WerSvc.
strings.Mapas sin conexión, modo demo de tienda: Offline maps, retail demo mode and fax.
strings.Con SSD y 32 GB apenas aporta, y quita l: With an SSD and 32 GB it barely helps, and it removes background disk reads. Apps may take a little longer to open the first time.
strings.Quita el indexador. Las apps siguen sali: Removes the indexer. Apps still show up in Start, but searching files and mail will be slower.
strings.Solo si NO imprimes ni usas \"Imprimir a: Only if you DON'T print or use "Print to PDF".
strings.Desactiva la geolocalización. Deja de fu: Turns off geolocation. Automatic time zone and local weather stop working.
strings.NO lo actives si usas Game Pass, la app: DON'T turn this on if you use Game Pass, the Xbox app or Microsoft Store games. Steam/Epic/Riot aren't affected.
strings.Pasan a manual: arrancan solo cuando alg: Set to manual: they only start when something needs them, like WinUtil does. Shortcut tracking, Compatibility Assistant, data usage, connected devices, Windows health, scanners and the Edge and Google updaters.
strings.Desactiva el servicio de directivas de d: Turns off the Diagnostic Policy Service and its hosts. Troubleshooters and per-app network usage in Task Manager stop working.
strings.SSDP y el host UPnP buscan televisores,: SSDP and the UPnP host keep scanning your network for TVs, printers and NAS boxes. If you don't share anything on your home network, you don't need them. Game UPnP (opening router ports) doesn't depend on them.
strings.Quita Teredo y los túneles IPv6. Algunas: Removes Teredo and IPv6 tunnels. Some VPNs and Xbox party chat use it; otherwise it's one less process.
strings.Equivale a Configuración > Energía > \"M: Same as Settings > Power > "Best performance" for the current power source. Uses more battery; set it while plugged in.
strings.Crea y activa el plan oculto Ultimate Pe: Creates and activates the hidden Ultimate Performance plan: the CPU never clocks down. Only for gaming plugged in; more heat and noise.
strings.Reserva menos CPU para tareas de fondo y: Reserves less CPU for background tasks and gives registered game threads high priority.
strings.Quita el límite que Windows pone a la re: Removes the limit Windows puts on the network while audio or video plays. Useful if you play online with Discord or music open.
strings.Las apps de la Store no se ejecutan en s: Store apps don't run in the background. Their notifications (Store WhatsApp, Mail...) may not arrive.
strings.Cada arranque carga el kernel y los driv: Every boot loads the kernel and drivers from scratch: avoids odd driver bugs and built-up memory.
strings.Quita las transparencias y las animacion: Removes transparency and window and taskbar animations. Needs a sign-out.
strings.Puede dar un 5-10 % más de FPS en alguno: Can give 5-10% more FPS in some games, at the cost of less protection against kernel-level malware. Some anti-cheats may require it on.
strings.Windows espera unos segundos antes de ab: Windows waits a few seconds before opening startup apps. Not needed with an SSD.
strings.Borra hiberfil.sys (entre el 40 % y el 1: Deletes hiberfil.sys (40% to 100% of your RAM, several GB of disk). While it's off there's no Fast Startup either; when you turn it back on, Fast Startup follows "Turn off Fast Startup". On a laptop, it will shut down instead of hibernating when the battery runs out.
strings.Windows prioriza el juego en primer plan: Windows prioritizes the game in the foreground and pauses Windows Update while you play.
strings.La GPU gestiona su propia cola de trabaj: The GPU manages its own work queue: lower latency and less CPU load. Required for Frame Generation.
strings.Desactiva la captura continua de la Xbox: Turns off the Xbox Game Bar's continuous capture. If you record clips with Win+G, leave it as it is.
strings.Desactiva \"Mejorar la precisión del pun: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision": movement is 1:1, better for aiming. Needs a sign-out.
strings.Pulsar Mayús cinco veces ya no saca el a: Pressing Shift five times no longer pops up Sticky Keys in the middle of a match.
strings.Sin reinicios automáticos con la sesión: No automatic restarts while signed in
strings.Windows Update no reinicia el equipo mie: Windows Update won't restart the PC while you're signed in; it tells you and you restart.
strings.Sin compartir actualizaciones con otros: Don't share updates with other PCs
strings.Desactiva la Optimización de distribució: Turns off Delivery Optimization (P2P): your connection doesn't upload updates to other PCs while you play online.
strings.No instalar drivers desde Windows Update: Don't install drivers from Windows Update
strings.Evita que Windows sustituya el driver de: Stops Windows from replacing the AMD/NVIDIA driver you installed. You'll have to install chipset, Wi-Fi and audio drivers yourself.
strings.Retrasar las versiones nuevas de Windows: Delay new Windows versions by a year
strings.Sigues recibiendo los parches de segurid: You still get security patches, but the big updates (25H2, 26H2...) arrive 365 days later, already polished.
strings.Recupera el menú de clic derecho complet: Brings back the full Windows 10 right-click menu (no "Show more options"). Restart File Explorer to see it.
strings.Clic derecho en un icono de la barra de: Right-click a taskbar icon to force-close a frozen game without opening Task Manager.
strings.Quita las fotos e \"información\" que Wi: Removes the photos and "facts" Windows downloads for the lock screen and desktop. You set your own wallpaper and that's it.
strings.Quita el botón de Vista de tareas y deja: Removes the Task View button and leaves search as an icon only. Win+Tab and Win+S still work.
strings.Unas 60 apps para todos los usuarios: No: About 60 apps for all users: News, Weather, Clipchamp, Solitaire, personal Teams, Copilot, Outlook (new), Office Hub, To Do, Maps, Dev Home, Widgets, Skype, old Mail and Calendar, and the sponsored ones (Candy Crush, TikTok, Facebook, Disney+...). Photos, Paint, Notepad, Snipping Tool, Calculator, Camera and the Store stay.
strings.Quita OneDrive y su sincronización en se: Removes OneDrive and its background sync. Your files in the OneDrive folder stay on disk. It can be reinstalled from onedrive.com.
strings.La app que conecta el móvil con el PC y: The app that connects your phone to the PC and stays in the background (PhoneExperienceHost, about 150 MB here). It can be reinstalled from the Store.
strings.Grabación de acciones de usuario, WordPa: Steps Recorder, WordPad, classic Windows Media Player and the Math Input Panel. They can be added back in Settings > System > Optional features.
strings.App Xbox, Game Bar y sus complementos. N: The Xbox app, Game Bar and their add-ons. DON'T do this if you use Game Pass, Store games, Win+G or Xbox chat. Steam, Epic and regular games aren't affected.
strings.Quita el navegador Edge y evita que Wind: Removes the Edge browser and stops Windows Update from reinstalling it. WebView2, used by many launchers, stays. Install another browser first. Windows only fully allows this in Europe; elsewhere it may refuse.
strings.Prioridad fuerte para la ventana activa: Strong priority for the active window
strings.Win32PrioritySeparation a 0x26: turnos d: Win32PrioritySeparation at 0x26: short CPU slices with a boost for the foreground program, which is the game.
strings.Windows deja de dormir los puertos USB p: Windows stops putting USB ports to sleep to save power: mouse, keyboard and controller without micro-dropouts. Plugged in only.
strings.Desactiva la administración de energía d: Turns off PCIe link state power management: the GPU and SSD don't drop power states between frames. Plugged in only.
strings.Todos los núcleos de la CPU quedan despi: All CPU cores stay awake while plugged in. Lower latency when a load starts, more power use and heat.
strings.TCP envía cada paquete al momento en vez: TCP sends every packet right away instead of batching them. Only helps games that use TCP (MMOs, older MOBAs); shooters use UDP.
strings.Modo MSI para la tarjeta gráfica: MSI mode for the graphics card
strings.La GPU avisa a la CPU con interrupciones: The GPU signals the CPU with message-signaled interrupts instead of line-based ones. Recent AMD and NVIDIA drivers usually already do this.
strings.Con 16 GB o más, comprimir la RAM gasta: With 16 GB or more, compressing RAM wastes CPU. With little memory it's better to leave it on.
strings.Seguro para casi todos los equipos. Quit: Safe for almost every PC. Removes almost everything useless.
strings.Más agresivo: puede quitar funciones que: More aggressive: it can remove features you use. Read each tweak before applying.
strings.Instalando {0} apps con winget. Puedes d: Installing {0} apps with winget. You can leave it running; don't close this window.
strings.winget no está disponible. Instala \"Ins: winget isn't available. Install "App Installer" from the Microsoft Store and open this file again.
strings.Listo: {0} instaladas, {1} ya estaban y: Done: {0} installed, {1} already there and {2} failed.
strings.Actualiza con winget todas las apps que: Updates every installed app with winget.
strings.Guarda un solo archivo que instala todo: Saves a single file that installs everything you picked on any PC, like Ninite.
strings.Con el motor de speed.cloudflare.com. Ga: Powered by speed.cloudflare.com. Uses 100 to 500 MB of data.
strings.Pulsa Iniciar test. Cierra descargas y s: Press Start test. Close downloads and streaming so the result is real.
strings.Instalando {0} apps con winget. Puedes d: Installing {0} apps with winget. You can leave it running.
strings.winget no está disponible. Instala \"Ins: winget isn't available. Install "App Installer" from the Microsoft Store.
strings.Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera y Firefox. No: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Firefox. Passwords, history and sessions aren't touched; websites load a bit slower the first time.
strings.Imágenes y webs que Discord y el navegad: Images and pages Discord and Steam's built-in browser keep. They're downloaded again when you use them.
strings.Logs de instalaciones y reparaciones (CB: Install and repair logs (CBS, DISM). Only useful to diagnose old problems.
strings.Cierra los navegadores antes para limpia: Close your browsers first to clean more.
strings.Optimiza Windows 11 para jugar, sin perd: Optimize Windows 11 for gaming, without losing the way back.
strings.OptiEleven quita la telemetría y los pro: OptiEleven strips telemetry and processes you don't need, gets your PC ready before every match and installs your apps in one go. Everything it changes can be undone with one click.
strings.Marca los tweaks seguros en la hoja de c: Ticks the safe tweaks on the change sheet. Nothing is applied until you press Apply changes.
strings.60 ajustes de privacidad, servicios, ren: 60 privacy, services, performance and latency tweaks, all reversible.
strings.Boost FPS de un clic: libera RAM, cierra: One-click Boost FPS: frees RAM, closes what you don't need and cleans up before you play.
strings.Más de 100 apps con su logo y un instala: Over 100 apps with their logos and a single installer, like Ninite.
strings.Temporales, cachés y restos de actualiza: Temp files, caches and update leftovers. See how much each takes before deleting.
strings.Test de velocidad, latencia y DNS más rá: Speed test, latency and faster DNS in one click.
strings.DISM, SFC, red, Windows Update y Store:: DISM, SFC, network, Windows Update and Store: the classic repairs.
strings.Todo es reversible: antes de cambiar alg: Everything is reversible: before changing anything, OptiEleven saves how it was.
strings.Algo ha fallado, pero el panel sigue abi: Something went wrong, but the panel is still open. Details are in Activity (Expert mode).
strings.Qué carpetas y archivos ocupan más en ca: Which folders and files take the most space on each drive, like WinDirStat.
strings.Abre la carpeta en el Explorador con el: Opens the folder in File Explorer with the file selected
strings.Elige un disco para ver qué carpetas y a: Pick a drive to see which folders and files take the most space. Click a folder to look inside it.
strings.Sin administrador, algunas carpetas del: Without administrator rights, some system folders can't be measured.
strings.Elige un disco. Pulsa una carpeta para d: Pick a drive. Click a folder to expand it and double-click to open it in File Explorer.
strings.Toca cualquier fila para ver qué claves,: Click any row to see which keys, services and tasks it changes, with the value now and after.
strings.Toca cualquier fila para ver qué hace y: Click any row to see what it does and whether it's safe. Or press Recommended to tick what suits almost everyone in one go.
strings.Muestra las claves del registro, servici: Shows the registry keys, services and tasks each tweak touches, and the activity log.
strings.Este no se puede deshacer desde el panel: This one can't be undone from the panel. Read the description carefully.
strings.Está aplicado. Si lo desactivas, Windows: It's applied. Turn it off and Windows goes back to how it was.
strings.Al aplicarlo se guarda cómo estaba, para: When applied, the original state is saved so you can revert it any time.
It's already like this on this PC.
strings.Activa el modo experto para ver qué clav: Turn on Expert mode to see which keys, services and tasks it changes.
strings.OptiEleven cambia ajustes de Windows. Ca: OptiEleven changes Windows settings. Almost everything can be reverted from the panel; what can't is labelled "No undo".
strings.El preset Recomendado es seguro para cas: The Recommended preset is safe for almost every PC.
strings.Avanzado y los ajustes marcados como Mod: Advanced, and tweaks tagged Moderate or Advanced, can remove features you use (Xbox, printing, search...). Read each description and apply them carefully, ideally one at a time.
strings.Crea un punto de restauración antes del: Create a restore point before your first change: System > Restore point.
You use OptiEleven at your own risk.
strings.Un clic antes de jugar: libera memoria,: One click before you play: frees memory, closes what's idling in the background, maxes out power and runs the full cleanup.
strings.Cerrar las apps marcadas abajo y pausar: Close the apps ticked below and pause the ticked services
strings.Hacer la limpieza completa: temporales,: Run the full cleanup: temp files, caches, shaders, thumbnails and Recycle Bin
strings.La papelera se vacía para siempre, y la: The Recycle Bin is emptied for good, and the first match in each game may stutter while the shader cache rebuilds.
strings.Al acabar de jugar, pulsa \"Terminar y r: When you're done playing, press "Finish and restore".
strings.Marca lo que quieres apartar mientras ju: Tick what you want out of the way while you play, and turn it on.
strings.Ábrelo como administrador para usar el b: Open it as administrator to use the booster.
strings.Libera la caché de archivos de la RAM, c: Frees the file cache in RAM, like ISLC. Useful if a game stutters after hours open.
strings.Mientras dura el booster. Al terminar vu: While the booster lasts. When it ends, your previous mode comes back.
strings.Deja más RAM libre para el juego desde e: Leaves more free RAM for the game from the first minute.
strings.Déjalo abierto si hablas mientras juegas: Leave it open if you talk while you play
strings.Booster activado. Pulsa \"Terminar y res: Booster on. Press "Finish and restore" when you're done playing.
strings.Booster terminado: todo vuelve a como es: Booster finished: everything is back to how it was.
strings.Booster: modo de energía en máximo rendi: Booster: power mode at best performance
Looking for games in Steam, Epic and GOG...
strings.No he encontrado juegos de Steam, Epic n: No Steam, Epic or GOG games found. Add a game's .exe by hand.
strings.Pantalla completa: quita la capa de Wind: Fullscreen: removes the Windows layer that turns fullscreen into a borderless window.
strings.winget está trabajando en su propia vent: winget is working in its own window. This list refreshes when you close it.
strings.Teams, Spotify y otras apps de la Store: Teams, Spotify and other Store apps are managed in Settings
strings.Se puede liberar con lo marcado: Can be freed with what's ticked
strings.Sin administrador solo se limpia lo de t: Without admin only your user's files are cleaned
strings.Lo que las apps dejan en %TEMP% y no bor: What apps leave in %TEMP% and never delete.
strings.Instaladores de actualizaciones que ya e: Installers for updates that are already applied.
strings.Copias de actualizaciones guardadas para: Copies of updates kept to share with other PCs.
strings.Informes de cuelgues de apps y de Window: App and Windows crash reports nobody will read.
strings.DirectX, AMD y NVIDIA. Límpiala tras cam: DirectX, AMD and NVIDIA. Clean it after changing drivers; the first match in each game will stutter while it rebuilds.
strings.Vistas previas de imágenes y vídeos. Se: Image and video previews. They're rebuilt when you open the folders.
strings.Se vacía entera. Lo que haya dentro no s: It's emptied completely. Whatever is in it can't be recovered.
The Recycle Bin is emptied for good.
strings.Cambiar de DNS no baja el ping del juego: Changing DNS doesn't lower in-game ping: it speeds up server lookups and loading websites and launchers.
strings.DISM repara la imagen del sistema y desp: DISM repairs the system image and then SFC replaces damaged files. The most useful repair when something fails for no reason.
strings.Busca errores en el sistema de archivos: Looks for errors in the C: file system without restarting. If it finds something, it tells you how to fix it.
strings.Para cuando hay conexión pero nada carga: For when you're connected but nothing loads, or ping went crazy after installing a VPN or an antivirus.
strings.Se reinician Winsock y TCP/IP. Hará falt: Winsock and TCP/IP get reset. You'll need to restart, and you may have to reconnect to Wi-Fi.
strings.Para actualizaciones que fallan una y ot: For updates that fail again and again or get stuck at a percentage.
strings.Se paran los servicios de actualización: The update services are stopped and their cache folders renamed. Windows creates them again.
strings.Borra versiones viejas de componentes qu: Deletes old component versions left by updates (WinSxS). Usually frees several GB.
strings.Vacía la caché de la Store. Para descarg: Clears the Store cache. For downloads that won't start or Game Pass games that won't install.
strings.Para iconos en blanco o equivocados en e: For blank or wrong icons on the desktop and taskbar. File Explorer restarts.
strings.Capacidad original frente a la actual y: Original versus current capacity and usage history. To know if the laptop battery is worn out.
strings.Para pedir ayuda en un foro, o comprobar: To ask for help on a forum, or to check your RAM runs at its rated speed and your GPU driver is up to date.
strings.Informe del equipo copiado al portapapel: PC report copied to the clipboard.
strings.abre el panel como admin para verlo: open the panel as admin to see it
strings.Enlace móvil no se reinstala solo: búsca: Phone Link doesn't reinstall by itself: find it in the Microsoft Store.
strings.Las apps quitadas no se reinstalan solas: Removed apps don't reinstall by themselves: find them in the Microsoft Store if you want any back.
strings.Las apps de Xbox se reinstalan desde Mic: The Xbox apps are reinstalled from the Microsoft Store (Xbox and Xbox Game Bar).
strings.Los componentes se vuelven a añadir en C: Components are added back in Settings > System > Optional features.
strings.OneDrive no se reinstala solo: descárgal: OneDrive doesn't reinstall by itself: download it from onedrive.com or with "winget install Microsoft.OneDrive".
strings.Edge se reinstala desde microsoft.com/ed: Edge is reinstalled from microsoft.com/edge or with "winget install Microsoft.Edge".
